insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer (Reload of Sum Insured)
great.quote: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, in case the available Sum Insured... is insufficient for covering a claim under the Policy as a result of previous claims in that Policy Year.
great.reference: Section C (I)(h) Reload of Sum Insured
great.explanation: Extra sum insured becomes available after you have used up the available Sum Insured during the policy year (once per year, for subsequent claims).

great.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 24 months
great.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Insurer.
great.explanation: PEDs are covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is better than many policies that take longer.

great.name: OPD benefit with no waiting periods (for OPD cover)
great.quote: Waiting periods do not apply in respect of this Beneﬁt.
great.reference: Section C.II (o) OPD Treatment, Condition IV
great.explanation: If OPD cover is part of your plan (as per schedule), OPD claims do not have waiting periods.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting for illnesses (accidents covered immediately).

good.name: Specific illness/procedure waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.

good.name: Restore/Refill benefit: Reload available but only for unrelated illness (not same illness) and only once per year
good.quote: Such reloading of Sum Insured shall be available only once during a Policy Year... The reload of Sum Insured shall be available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C (I)(h) Reload of Sum Insured, Conditions (ii) and (iii)
good.explanation: This is a refill-like feature, but it does not help for the same illness/complication within the same policy year, and it is limited to once per year.

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home-based treatment (when hospitalization is not possible/bed not available) is covered as per limits.

good.name: AYUSH inpatient hospitalization covered
good.quote: We shall cover... towards the Medical Expenses for In-patient Hospitalization incurred with respect to the Insured Person’s Ayush Treatment undergone in any AYUSH Hospital or AYUSH Day care Center.
good.explanation: AYUSH inpatient treatment is covered as per policy limits.

good.name: Air ambulance / evacuation assistance (as part of emergency assistance services)
good.quote: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Emergency evacuation/repatriation assistance is included (subject to conditions such as travel distance and prior coordination with insurer’s provider).

good.name: No Claim Bonus present but reduces on claim (does not reset to zero)
good.quote: The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 50% of the Sum Insured... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
good.explanation: You can build NCB up to 50% of SI; on a claim it reduces by 10% of SI (not a full reset to zero).

good.name: Optional cover trade-off: PPN discount with co-pay outside PPN
good.quote: If this option is chosen... discount of 10% on the premium... If the Insured Person takes Inpatient hospitalization treatment... in a Hospital other than those listed as “Preferred Provider Network”, then... shall bear a Co-Payment of 15% on each and every claim
good.explanation: This is optional: you may choose lower premium, but pay 15% co-pay if you take inpatient treatment outside the preferred network.

bad.name: Room rent limit not clearly stated in wording (subject to schedule) and can trigger proportionate/rateable deductions
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent... up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C (I)(a) In-patient Hospitalization, What is covered (1)
bad.explanation: Room eligibility is not specified here; if your plan has a capped/limited room category, higher room choice can cause major out-of-pocket via proportionate deductions. Check your Policy Schedule for the exact room entitlement.

bad.name: Proportionate (rateable) deduction if room category higher than entitlement (applies when room is limited in schedule)
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: If your room rent is not ‘any room/no limit’ as per schedule, choosing a higher room can proportionately reduce admissible doctor/OT/nursing etc. (big payout reduction).

bad.name: Consumables not covered (listed as non-medical / excluded items)
bad.quote: Activ Care Policy Wordings - Annexure - I - List of Non-medical expenses... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure I – List of Non-medical expenses (List I)
bad.explanation: Common consumables and kits are typically excluded as non-medical expenses, leading to out-of-pocket costs during hospitalization.

bad.name: Disease-specific sub-limits present (listed illnesses sublimit)
bad.quote: Sublimit for listed illnesses: We will cover the Medical Expenses arising out of an Insured Person’s in-patient Hospitalization for the listed Illness/ conditions and limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table.
bad.reference: Section C (I)(j) Sublimit for listed illnesses
bad.explanation: Having sub-limits for listed illnesses can reduce payouts versus full Sum Insured coverage. Exact illnesses/amounts depend on schedule.

bad.name: Mandatory co-pay for entry age 61+ (percentage depends on schedule)
bad.quote: if the Age (Age at entry) of the Insured Person or eldest Insured Person... is 61 years or above... shall bear a Co-payment per claim... as speciﬁed in Product Beneﬁt Table/Policy Schedule.
bad.explanation: For senior entry (61+), a co-pay applies on each claim (the percentage is as per schedule), reducing effective coverage.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization expenses duration (days) not specified in wording
unclear.quote: We shall cover... the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C (I)(b) Pre – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: The number of days covered before admission is not stated here. If not found in your schedule, assume it is not available.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization expenses duration (days) not specified in wording
unclear.quote: We shall cover... the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C (I)(c) Post – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: The number of days covered after discharge is not stated here. If not found in your schedule, assume it is not available.

unclear.name: Default co-pay for ages below 61 not explicitly stated
unclear.quote: Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a speciﬁed percent age of the admissible claims amount.
unclear.explanation: Policy defines co-pay and separately states mandatory co-pay for 61+ entry, but does not clearly state whether there is any default co-pay for others. Verify in Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table.

unclear.name: Cashless network size (number of hospitals) not specified
unclear.quote: Cashless Facilities can be availed only at Our Network Providers/ Empanelled Service Providers. The complete list of Network Providers and Empaneled Service Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: Network exists, but the count of hospitals is not provided in the wording. Check insurer website or your plan details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
